**Finding submitted: deviation (NONCOMPETE), preferred-level redline.**

- **Responsive clause:** Section 6.1 (Article 6 "Exclusivity", p0037) — a Customer-side covenant barring the Company from any similar Internet project involving Deerskin Products or "products substantially similar," plus HDI's exclusive right to our own "Deerskin" brand.
- **Why it fails fallback:** scope is not a single named product (open-ended "substantially similar"/"companies similar to"); no 12-month cap (Section 4.1 auto-renews annually, so "during the term" is indefinite); no internal-development carve-out; no acquisitions carve-out (Section 6.2 covers only closeout merchandise). Preferred is separately defeated by HDI's exclusive right over our own brand.
- **Cure:** one surgical replacement of 6.1 with a short no-restriction statement; Section 6.2 (our retained closeout rights) and Section 6.3 (HDI-side restriction, which benefits us) left intact, with no dangling cross-references.
